## Pathway Description

A professional project or analysis focusing on a topic relevant to the student’s selected concentration and career goals. The audience for a master’s project is typically planning and policy practitioners and decisionmakers. The capstone deliverable may be a report, a plan, or other professional quality work. The project is conducted for or with an external client.
